column20: Pro Juv1,2,3 and Pro Adu 1,2,3 indicate pronotum length measured three times in last-instar juvenile and adult ecolsion (mm)
Juv_Right_Forewing_length and Juv_Right_Hindwing_length: right forewing and hindwing length was measured in last-instar juvenile (mm)

Adult_Top or Left_Forewing_length and Adult_Right_Forewing_length: Adult left- and right forewing length was measured for Sw individuals, but only the wing folded on the top was measured for Lw individuals.
Weight_Adu: Body mass was measured on the day of adult eclosion (g).
